label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Taylor Moore leads RBC Canadian Open
items.text: Taylor Moore is 5-under through six holes to lead the RBC Canadian Open at TPC Toronto, one shot ahead of Brice Garnett and with Mac Meissner and Roger Sloan three shots back.

items.headline: Bryson DeChambeau eyes PGA Tour return
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau is reportedly trying to rejoin the PGA Tour as his LIV Golf contract ends, despite PGA Tour CEO Brian Rolapp's stringent penalties for LIV returnees.

items.headline: 64-year-old hits longest recorded drive
items.text: A 64-year-old golfer achieved the longest drive ever officially recorded, highlighting how modern golf has pushed driving distances to new levels.
